name: lite3-pro-parametric-model
title: Lite3 LiDAR high-fidelity printable replica
description: Accepted Fusion Rev B baseline of the opaque user-provided Lite3 B-rep with manufacturer J17A, J20A, S410, and Mid-360 B-reps. Dr Sun rejected the invented four-receiver chassis proxy and authorized a model-only J17A correction: preserve the source J17A and relocate only its two front stepped holes from 67.882250994 mm pitch onto the two 64.999999659 mm-pitch shallow chassis-hole axes. The accepted state is frozen locally as a complete F3D archive and adapted-J17A STEP.
creator: sun
notes: Current evidence is factory-step-j17a-front-pair-65mm-adapted-rev-b. Dr Sun rejected factory-step-lite3-venture-receiver-proxy-rev-a because its invented four chassis receivers bypassed the actual front two small-hole screw axes. Rev A is hidden and retained only as rejected evidence. Rev B preserves the source J17A and creates J17A_FRONT_PAIR_65MM_ADAPTED_REV_B_NOT_OFFICIAL_CAD: only the two front diameter 4.5 mm through / diameter 8.0 mm counterbored holes are healed and relocated onto the source robot's diameter 2.5 mm central / diameter 8.0 mm shallow-recess axes at 64.999999659 mm pitch; the rear J17A pair remains unchanged. The diameter 8 mm J17A recess is the screw-head seat, the diameter 4.5 mm bore is shaft clearance, and the diameter 2.5 mm chassis opening is the receiving/pilot feature; their unequal diameters are expected. The complete J17A/J20A/S410/Mid-360 stack moves rigidly by [-0.151878610, -3.128370000, +40.923512315] mm in world [X,Y,Z]. Maximum adapted-axis line residual is 3.0838e-13 mm, the derived body is one valid B-rep with zero mesh bodies, all occurrence rotations have determinant +1, and exact checks find zero positive solid intersection. Dr Sun said 继续，执行 on 2026-07-27. Fusion exported the accepted complete state to lite3-j17a-front-pair-65mm-rev-b.f3d and the adapted component to j17a-front-pair-65mm-adapted-rev-b.step; hashes and clean STEP import metrics are in validation_report.json. Exact thread, screw length, engagement, torque, anti-rotation, service access, and load path remain unresolved. The active Fusion tab remains Untitled; the task stays in_progress until the broader sensor/robot work continues.
